{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the ammunition type|the [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slow-moving creature]] or the [[Peace Brigade]]r [[Gad Sluggins|"Slug"]]}}
A '''slug''' or '''bullet''' was a solid projectile used in [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]].<ref name="AE">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> Slugs varied in caliber, meaning that the ammunition was not compatible with all slugthrowers. They were made of varied materials, including metal, [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramics]], and [[Plastic/Legends|hardened plastics]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Varying in size, slugs could range from small calibers used in [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistols]] to much larger [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] rounds used by planetary defenses. In smaller calibers, specialty slugs allowed for an incredible array of specialized ammunition, and featured [[Mercy (slug)|mercy]] slugs made from soft gels for stunning rather than killing, specialized [[pyro]] slugs which used combustible materials to light targets on fire, [[Explosive slug|explosive]] rounds,<ref name="AE" /> including ones tipped with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]],<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> and [[Deuterium/Legends|Deuterium]]<ref name="Card">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]]</ref> rounds, armor-piercing rounds made from depleted [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]],<ref name="Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> rounds configured to release toxic gas, [[stun gas]], and [[Acid/Legends|acid]],<ref name="EGWT" /> and even anti-[[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] rounds made from [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], which were capable of shorting out lightsabers.<ref name="Cad">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>
